Big Banyan Harvest Festival 2026

    Step into a vineyard celebration like no other at Big Banyan Harvest Festival 2026 - a vibrant celebration of the vineyard’s harvest season and a joyful coming together of wine, food, music, and rustic experiences set amid the natural beauty of Big Banyan Vineyard & Resort. Designed as a three-day immersive festival, it captures the romance of grape harvesting traditions while blending them with contemporary lifestyle experiences, making it appealing to families, young audiences, wine lovers, and corporate groups alike. The festival atmosphere is lively yet rooted in authenticity, with décor, storytelling, and activities reflecting the journey from vine to wine. At its heart, the harvest festival celebrates participation and discovery. Guests step into the role of harvesters through curated grape-picking slots, interactive wine stomping, tasting sessions, vineyard brunches, and themed Hi-Tea experiences. A wide spread of artisan food stalls, smoked meats, barbecue counters, gourmet brunches, dinners and grape-inspired creations, paired with your favourite Big Banyan Wines, elevate the culinary dimension. The Bonfire evenings, curated retail stalls, and rustic vineyard trails add layers of warmth and nostalgia, encouraging guests to slow down, explore, and celebrate the season. Live entertainment forms the emotional high point each evening. Enjoy live performances every evening by Lagori on Friday, 13th March, Raag The Band on Saturday, 14th March, and a grand finale by Sanjith Hegde on Sunday, 15th March. The mood is electric and exciting. With activities for all ages and picture-perfect vineyard moments, it’s a celebration designed for families, friends, and wine lovers alike 🎶🔥 Duration: 20265 Hours. Languages: Hindi.
